request.prompt: Scene: inside the hall of the pale-stone gate tower at eye height. A big wooden winch with an iron axle, the crank fitted to it; beside it the inside of the great oak gate, chains running up from it into the dark of the tower; a ladder up the inner wall; sunlight through an arrow slit.
